nodes.label: OLMo-core v2 Design and Upgrade Guide
Mamba3MixerConfig (Mamba-3 Sequence Mixer)
nodes.rationale: Dispatch prefers the fused mamba-ssm Triton kernel where eligible and falls back to a chunked or pure-PyTorch reference path otherwise, so the same config runs on hardware/shape combinations the fused kernel does not cover.

nodes.label: Mamba3Config (Mamba-3 Attention Hybrid Model)
nodes.rationale: Interleaves Mamba-3 SSM blocks with attention rather than replacing attention outright, keeping attention's exact recall alongside the SSM's linear-cost mixing.

nodes.label: rotation_block_size (Transition Block Size b)
nodes.rationale: b = 2 reproduces the paper's abelian complex-diagonal transition, which is only TC-zero; b >= 3 uses a non-solvable SO(3) rotation whose prefix product is a genuine NC-one scan, giving the layer state-tracking power a diagonal SSM provably lacks.

nodes.label: NC-one Prefix Scan State Tracking
nodes.rationale: A diagonal (abelian) SSM transition is confined to TC-zero and provably cannot track state; a non-solvable rotation group makes the prefix product NC-one-hard and recovers that expressivity.

nodes.label: rotation_scan_impl (Prefix Product Strategy)
nodes.rationale: Chooses how the b >= 3 prefix product is computed; the quaternion formulation is the fastest of the available implementations.

nodes.label: theta_max (Bounded Per-Step Rotation Angle)
nodes.rationale: Bounds the angle via theta_max * tanh(theta / theta_max) because unbounded angles let the rotation wind arbitrarily far per step and were observed to diverge mid-run at every b, not only b >= 3.

nodes.label: exempt_timescale_params_from_weight_decay
nodes.rationale: Decaying A_log and dt_bias moves the recurrence's timescale rather than regularizing a weight: it pulls |A| toward 1 and dt toward softplus(0), squeezing the memory horizon from both ends. On by default and recorded in the checkpoint config.

nodes.label: no_weight_decay_param_names
nodes.rationale: Collects fully-qualified names of parameters a module tagged _no_weight_decay so modules can declare decay exemptions locally instead of callers hand-listing parameter names.

nodes.label: max_checkpoints Retention Limit
nodes.rationale: Defaults to 3 and removes the oldest permanent checkpoints once exceeded; set to None to restore the previous keep-everything behavior.

nodes.label: Clone-Before-Serialize Checkpoint Write
nodes.rationale: Serializing a view or shared tensor directly writes its full backing storage; cloning each tensor first avoids the bloat, and a guard raises OLMoCheckpointError if a written tensor exceeds its nbytes.

nodes.label: OutputDiscardCheckpoint
nodes.rationale: Standard activation checkpointing targets intermediates, but for precision casts and FFN up-projections the region's output dominates memory. Forward runs under no_grad, the output's storage is freed after downstream consumption, and a backward hook recomputes and rebinds the freed storage in place.

nodes.label: share_storage C++ Extension
nodes.rationale: Rebinds recomputed data into freed storage in place; ships with a Python fallback so environments without a C++ toolchain still work.

nodes.label: determinism_check Option
nodes.rationale: Defaults to 'default'; setting it to 'none' skips torch's recompute metadata check, which opaque linear-attention kernels under torch.compile cannot satisfy.

nodes.label: Qwen3.5 Dense Model Configs
nodes.rationale: 0.8B, 4B, 9B and 27B configs use a hybrid Gated DeltaNet plus full-attention architecture.

nodes.label: SequenceMixer Base Class
nodes.rationale: Common base for both attention and recurrent layers so hybrid blocks can be swapped without special-casing the mixer type.

nodes.label: ABF / PI / YaRN RoPE Scaling Strategies
VisionEncoderConfig
nodes.rationale: One configurable encoder covers OpenAI CLIP, SigLIP and SigLIP2 variants so Molmo2 checkpoints can be loaded through factory configs rather than bespoke model classes.

nodes.label: MultimodalLM
nodes.rationale: Composite vision-language model that fuses image patch tokens directly into the LM token stream.

nodes.label: block_pattern Hybrid Block Selection
nodes.rationale: TransformerConfig.block accepts a dict of named TransformerBlockConfigs paired with a block_pattern list, so hybrid architectures pick a block type per layer instead of hardcoding interleaving.

nodes.label: ModuleConfig Base Class
nodes.rationale: All olmo_core.nn module configs inherit from one base class so config handling is uniform across the nn package.

nodes.label: LMHead
nodes.rationale: Output when labels are passed is a 4-tuple (logits, loss, ce_loss, z_loss) so the combined loss and its components are separable by callers.

nodes.label: FlashAttention4Backend
nodes.rationale: Adds paged KV cache support for inference on Blackwell (SM >= 10.0) GPUs.

nodes.label: TEAttentionBackend (TransformerEngine)
nodes.rationale: torch.compile tracing is disabled through its forward because the Python/pybind setup is not Dynamo-safe.

nodes.label: InitMethod.fan_in
nodes.rationale: Per-layer fan-in initialization where each weight matrix uses std = 1/sqrt(d_in).

nodes.label: Qwen3 RoPE Input-Dtype Fix
nodes.rationale: HuggingFace applies RoPE in the input dtype (bf16); upcasting to fp32 made OLMo-core's Qwen3 numerically diverge from the reference implementation.

nodes.label: Auxiliary-Loss-Free MoE Load Balancing
nodes.rationale: Balances experts by adjusting a router bias instead of adding an auxiliary loss term, avoiding the gradient interference that a balancing loss introduces.

nodes.label: TrainModule Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates both model and optimizer so the Trainer no longer owns them separately; several options (rank_microbatch_size, fused_loss, compile_loss, z_loss_multiplier, autocast_precision, dp/tp/float8 configs) moved here from the Trainer and model config.

nodes.label: TransformerTrainModuleConfig
nodes.rationale: Can build a TransformerPipelineTrainModule via a pp_config spec, making TransformerPipelineTrainModuleConfig redundant though it is kept for backwards compatibility.

nodes.label: Transformer.init_weights
nodes.rationale: Under interleaved pipeline parallelism (Interleaved1F1B, InterleavedZeroBubble) the multiple model chunks owned by one rank initialized to identical parameters; folding model_part_idx * pp_size into the seed disambiguates them.

nodes.label: num_flops_per_token Under Pipeline Parallelism
nodes.rationale: Each PP rank only holds its stage's layers, so summing FLOPs from model_parts undercounts the model. The fix captures model.num_flops_per_token as a bound method before split_model deepcopies and drops layers, then calls it at metric time; on meta device (the standard PP init path) this costs no memory.

nodes.label: init_distributed()
nodes.rationale: Bootstraps a minimal single-process environment (RANK=0, WORLD_SIZE=1, MASTER_ADDR/MASTER_PORT) when launch env vars are absent so scripts run directly without torchrun for single-process debugging; also checks dist.is_initialized() before init_process_group().

nodes.label: OLMO_RICH_LOGGING Env Var
nodes.rationale: Previously any value force-enabled rich logging; now 0/false/no/off explicitly disables it so the variable can express both intents.

nodes.label: PowerLR Scheduler
nodes.rationale: Power-decay phase lr = initial_lr * (current / warmup) ** b with negative b makes the LR independent of the training horizon, so the schedule need not be re-tuned when total steps change.

nodes.label: ComposableScheduler
nodes.rationale: Piecewise schedule on an absolute time axis, which is why it ignores the t_max passed to get_lr and emits a once-per-instance UserWarning to that effect.

nodes.label: OverrideDecay Late-Stage Decay Override
nodes.rationale: When current >= override_decay.start the main schedule is interrupted mid-flight and the LR decays from the value the main schedule would have produced at start to a target LR over duration, allowing an anneal to be bolted onto a run that was not planned for one.

nodes.label: warmup_fraction Option
nodes.rationale: Lets warmup be specified as a fraction of total training steps rather than an absolute step count.

nodes.label: NoOpOptimizer
nodes.rationale: Does nothing and uses no memory, which isolates optimizer cost when debugging.

nodes.label: GAPMonitorCallback (Gradients/Activations/Parameters)
nodes.rationale: dump_gradients=True saves raw gradient tensors during training with full distributed checkpoint support and a preview mode (dump_gradients_save_first_n) to bound output size.

nodes.label: StabilityMonitorCallback
nodes.rationale: Detects training instability via spike detection in loss and gradient norm.

nodes.label: A100 Peak FLOPs Spec Fix
nodes.rationale: The A100 peak flops spec was 2x too low, which inflated reported MFU by 2x.

nodes.label: HFConverterCallback
nodes.rationale: Converts models to HuggingFace format at the end of the training run so conversion is not a separate manual step.

nodes.label: ConfigSaverCallback
nodes.rationale: Automatically sets the config to save for other callbacks (WandB, Comet, Beaker) so each does not need to be wired up individually.

nodes.label: DataCollator
nodes.rationale: Optional vocab_size field validates token IDs are in [0, vocab_size) before the batch reaches the model, catching corrupt data at the boundary rather than as an opaque CUDA indexing failure.

nodes.label: Packed Numpy FSL Dataset (Bin Packing)
nodes.rationale: Packs documents into sequences using best-fit-decreasing bin packing to reduce truncation waste; source_group_size can group multiple npy source files for packing.

nodes.label: Interleaved Numpy FSL Dataset
nodes.rationale: Interleaves several documents into a sequence as a recipe for efficiently extending context length.

nodes.label: SourceMixtureDataset
nodes.rationale: Composes a training mixture from ratios of source datasets rather than concatenating pre-mixed files.

nodes.label: NumpyDatasetConfig
nodes.rationale: Split into a separate config per underlying dataset class so each dataset variant's options stand alone.

nodes.label: Variable Sequence Length (VSL) Datasets and Curriculums
ignore_fingerprint_mismatch
nodes.rationale: Allows resuming training from a checkpoint whose dataset mix differs from the current one, which is required for midtraining and mix swaps.

nodes.label: LongSkywork: A Training Recipe for Efficiently Extending Context Length
Dataset Decomposition: Faster LLM Training with Variable Sequence Length Curriculum
Deterministic In-Loop Eval Ordering
nodes.rationale: LM in-loop evaluator data order drifted across repeated runs; resetting loader bookkeeping before each pass and defaulting to deterministic reshuffling fixes it, with a documented `deterministic` option so callers can opt out.

nodes.label: DownstreamEvaluatorCallbackConfig
nodes.rationale: A `lazy` option loads each task on demand, which can decrease startup time.

nodes.label: GenerationModule
nodes.rationale: Native OLMo-core autoregressive generation with kv caching, and the ability to load and average multiple checkpoints at once.

nodes.label: olmo_core.generate.chat Interface
nodes.rationale: Allows interacting with OlmoCore models directly, without converting them to another format first.

nodes.label: RunDuration (Chinchilla Multipliers)
nodes.rationale: Configures training durations in terms of Chinchilla multipliers instead of raw step counts.

nodes.label: Removal of Fused Cross-Entropy Loss Variant
nodes.rationale: The fused CE loss had a bug and consistently under-performed the native PyTorch version when compiled, so it was removed rather than repaired.

nodes.label: mark_dynamic Compile Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Excluded from torch.compile tracing via @torch.compiler.disable; marking cu_doc_lens and max_doc_len dynamic avoids dynamo recompiles when intra-document masking is enabled.

nodes.label: OLMO_CORE_FS_CACHE_DIR Remote IO Cache
nodes.rationale: Caches results of remote IO operations like get_file_size() and deterministic_glob_directory() to a local directory, cutting repeated remote round-trips.

nodes.label: nn.buffer_cache.BufferCache
nodes.rationale: A namespace option ensures RoPE modules with different settings use a unique sub-cache, fixing context-parallel blocks that all shared one RoPE buffer.

nodes.label: HF_HOME CI Cache
nodes.rationale: Caching HF_HOME across CPU Test CI runs stops the HuggingFace roundtrip tests (Qwen3-0.6B, Gemma-3-270m) from re-downloading their checkpoints every run.
